name: Graveyard Walk
source:
You enjoy your daily walks through the cemetery but one night you find you're not alone. Are these denizens of the graveyard friend or foe?

[From [url=https://shelldragon.itch.io/graveyard-walk]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你喜欢每天在墓地散步，但有一天晚上你发现自己并不孤单。这些墓地居民是朋友还是敌人？

[来自[url=https://shelldragon.itch.io/graveyard-walk]Itch.io[/url]]
